text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—I'd like to use this hot springs trip 
ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as our "journey" with Dream Journey 
had reached a milestone, she said those 
words to me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Then, could you just adjust the dates? I 
will handle putting together the action 
plan—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh. You look like a deer caught in 
headlights.
choice_data_list: Um, weren't you going with your family...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We'll go another time. Consider this a 
preliminary scoutingâ

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's also meant to be an appreciation 
party for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Up until today, you have devoted 
yourself entirely to me."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I would very much like you to take this 
opportunity to relax and stretch your 
wings at the hot springs... That is what I 
am thinking."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
......As someone who walked the same 
"journey."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It felt like a truly gentle smile, born 
of nothing but sheer goodwill.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Then... it's settled, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. The food is wonderful too. So 
much care and thought put into every 
little detail—"
choice_data_list:
...This really is a wonderful, relaxing 
inn.

...This really is such a relaxing, lovely 
inn.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like you were able to rest 
well, and that is what matters most.
choice_data_list: Journey. Thank you so much for this time

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...You're very welcome.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“......After this, would you like to go 
for a short walk?”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
According to the inn staff, there's a 
river nearby where fireflies gather. They 
say it's exceptionally beautiful this time 
of year.
choice_data_list: Oh...! That does make you curious.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Right? Shall we go, as a souvenir of 
today's journey?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—I didn't think much of it at the time, 
though.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whwoooooosh......――)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were no streetlights on the road to 
the destination. Though well-maintained 
and sure-footed, one could barely see 
ahead by the moonlight.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Claiming to have better night vision than 
humans, Dream Journey went ahead to check 
the path, her voice echoing back from the 
darkness.
choice_data_list: I don't think I can see it...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I got a bit ahead of myself, 
didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —My vision rapidly grows even darker.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like thick clouds have covered 
the moon.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Could you please keep coming straight 
toward where I am?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It's okay—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pshhh—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A faintly echoing, familiar sound. 
After a brief pause, that aroma tickles my 
nostrils—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Now...... this way.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, there's nothing dangerous on 
the path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relying on that scent, she took one step, 
and then another, into the darkness—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Gotcha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey grasps my hand. At that very 
moment, the moonlight begins to return as 
well—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...You figured it out well.
choice_data_list:
...Because it's the scent of our precious 
contract.

......Because it's the scent of our 
precious contract

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear me—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ……You really are something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Dream Journey and I walked to 
our destination holding hands—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, the two of us gazed at the night 
river, adorned by moonlight and fireflies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That "This night belongs only to us."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words she murmured... It felt like I 
would never be able to forget them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Dream Journey 
and myself...
